## Import Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse) # Easily Install and Load the 'Tidyverse', CRAN v2.0.0
library(gt) # Easily Create Presentation-Ready Display Tables, CRAN v0.10.0
source("source/color_palettes.R")

```


```{r}
df <- readxl::read_excel("data/Nikon-Widefield/cell_counts_tidy_with_post.xlsx")
```


```{r}
p_cell_count <- df |>
  mutate(condition = fct_rev(condition)) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = condition,
      y = cells_per_ml,
      fill = condition
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(color = "black", position = position_dodge()) +
  facet_wrap(well ~ depth) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Cells per mL"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_cell_count

ggsave(
  filename = "fig_output/cell_count_summary_plot.pdf",
  plot = p_cell_count,
  height = 6,
  width = 5
)
```
